spec_match.rationale: Guided real-gesture matrix scoped honestly to the two documented discriminators (touch scroll, right click); the in-place hold row correctly states both models close on release.

interactive.rationale: Real popover/dialog surfaces driven by real gestures with verdicts derived from actual toggle/close events.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes discriminating gestures from ambiguous ones; mouse drags and holds are explicitly labelled non-discriminating rather than mislabelled; initial mislabelled verdicts were caught by trusted-input verification and corrected before commit.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus entry, HTML PR #11536, pointerevents#542 linked.

conformance.rationale: New suite mixes falsifiable script checks with honest manual gesture contracts; the right-click contract records its verified pre-153 failure.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Trusted CDP input on Chromium 141 after the final edit: plain click closed; 504ms hold stayed open until release ('as both models predict'); right-click outside DISMISSED — the real pre-153 behavior, correctly labelled OLD. Touch-path attribution unverified in this harness (recorded as an open question). Zero console errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts on every recorded gesture verdict branch.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons, labelled arenas/tables, role=status and role=log live regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Parity harness 2026-08-16: desktop OK, mobile OK, no overflow, clean console/network.

openQuestions.title: Verify the touch-pan and 153+ branches on real hardware
openQuestions.detail: Synthetic CDP touch did not map to pointer input in the headless harness, and no 153 build exists here; the touch-pan survived/dismissed attributions and the 153 right-click stay-open branch are implemented but unverified. Exercise on a real touch device and a Chrome 153 build.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce state changes via live regions; keep native popover/dialog semantics; label test surfaces.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: role=status readouts and a role=log timeline announce every verdict; native popover/closedby dialog used untouched.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Trusted-input CDP runs read the live-region text after each gesture.

guidanceConsulted.query: popover light dismiss closedby dialog behavior
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer declarative popover/closedby over scripted dismissal handling.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Demos use the native attributes exclusively; the page only observes, never reimplements, dismissal.
